mapper.select: SELECT business_id, member_id, loan_purpose, industry_code, business_period, revenue, employees, place_type, created_at, survey_completed_at FROM user_business_info WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT business_id as businessId, member_id as memberId, loan_purpose as loanPurpose, industry_code as industryCode, business_period as businessPeriod, revenue, employees, place_type as placeType, created_at as createdAt FROM user_business_info WHERE business_id = #{businessId}
